mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 79 degrees and clear near Verona City Hall with an air quality index of 52. The new moon is out tonight, and you can spot the International Space Station at 9:08 PM for 4 minutes as it travels from the West over Mount Horeb toward the Northeast near the Home Depot, reaching about halfway up the sky.

In city news, a 19-year-old suspect is facing charges of burglary and recklessly endangering safety after an incident at a residence on Hunter's Cove Way on September 10. Additionally, the Verona Police Department is currently accepting applications for its free nine-week Citizen Academy program, which runs from September 23 through November 18.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol or live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival takes place on September 13.
The Verona Police Department reported that on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in progress on Hunter's Cove Way where a handgun was recovered and one suspect was taken into custody.
Today's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will be serving until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
